game.title: The Last of Us Remastered
game.blurb: Post-apocalyptic action-adventure in which Joel escorts Ellie across a ruined America, from Naughty Dog, released 2014-07-29 on PlayStation 4 as a remaster of the 2013 game. RAWG average playtime: 16 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from the Steam achievements of the PC remake, The Last of Us Part I.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). IMPORTANT: The Last of Us Remastered is a PlayStation 4 game (RAWG lists only PlayStation 4) with no Steam release. The Steam app used here, 1888930, is "The Last of Us Part I", the 2022 PC remake (RAWG lists it separately as "The Last of Us Part I", 2022-09-02). Its achievement list is used only as a stand-in for chapter themes and collectibles; it may differ from the Remastered PS4 trophy list and should be checked before release. The Steam schema calls the app "Texas" (an internal codename). None of its 29 achievements is hidden. It covers the main game ("Complete Part 1") and Left Behind ("Complete Left Behind", plus the Jak X game, brick, Black Fang and water gun contests). StrategyWiki has the guide under "The Last of Us" (completion stage 0, marked a stub); only Controls and Table of Contents subpages exist, and Walkthrough, Gameplay and Trophies are linked but not written. thelastofus.fandom.com answers the API under "The Last of Us", with 500 or more linked pages (the link list was cut off at 500); it also has a "The Last of Us Part I" page with about 112 links. Names only were looked at, nothing copied.
